items.title: The Clarity Act would've had a 'downside' for Coinbase, CEO explains
items.summary: The US Senate voted 49–50 against advancing the Clarity Act, a key piece of proposed crypto market-structure legislation. Coinbase (COIN) CEO Brian Armstrong explains that, although the bill would have been beneficial overall, it also could've created complications for Coinbase. Disclosure: Yahoo Finance has a partnership with Coinbase.

items.title: Why banks blew it on the Clarity Act, while crypto brokers operate as normal
items.summary: Scott Melker and Coinbase (COIN) CEO Brian Armstrong discuss how big banks fumbled the Clarity Act by getting caught up in stablecoin rewards, potentially leaving themselves worse off as crypto brokers continue operating as usual. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Clarity Act Hopes Remain, But Crypto "Can't Wait For Congress Anymore"
items.summary: The Clarity Act has a narrowing window to pass. Senate Democrats remain committed to passing the crypto bill as SEC, CFTC push rules.

items.title: SEC Opens Door To Tokenized Stocks With New ‘Innovation Exemption’
items.summary: The exemption allows Tokenized Securities Venues to use permissioned automated market makers and liquidity pools.

items.title: Coinbase Retail Take Rates Look Unsustainable, Says Mizuho — Robinhood Competition Could Force Further Fee Cuts
items.summary: Mizuho says Coinbase’s new fee structure begins addressing trading costs but expects competitive pressure to spread beyond its most active users, according to TheFly.
